column4: PR #2396: test-only package (not a _test.go file, so importable from another package's test code) building real, cryptographically-signed SAML IdP fixtures via crewjam/saml's own IdP-side machinery, mirroring internal/saml's own test fixture construction, so callers like server/faultops' fuzz harness drive (*saml.Provider).ParseResponse's actual signature-verification path; package doc states no production code should import this package.
